item.title: ECI extends electoral roll revision deadline in five states, UTs to 19 Jan
item.description: Election Commission of India extends electoral roll revision deadline in five states, UTs to 19 January

item.title: IMF says oil prices steady so far despite Venezuela and Iran tensions
item.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Thursday it is closely tracking global energy markets amid rising geopolitical tensions involving Venezuela and Iran, but stressed that oil prices have yet to experience any major disruption.

item.title: India, US and UK urge citizens in Israel to stay alert amid security concerns
item.description: India, the United States and the United Kingdom have issued fresh advisories for their nationals in Israel, urging heightened vigilance and warning against unnecessary travel amid an uncertain security situation in the region.

item.title: Israel strikes kill 10 in Gaza as US unveils phase two of ceasefire deal
item.description: Israel strikes kill 10 in Gaza as US unveils phase two of ceasefire deal

item.title: Delhi-NCR air quality drops to very poor as cold wave and fog intensify
item.description: Air quality across Delhi-NCR deteriorated sharply on Friday morning, with several locations slipping into the ‘very poor’ category, as cold wave conditions and dense fog gripped the region.

item.title: Guterres urges powerful nations to lead push for UN Security Council reform
item.description: UN chief António Guterres urges the world’s most powerful nations to lead Security Council reform, warning that clinging to outdated privileges today could come at a heavy cost tomorrow.

item.title: Allahabad High Court orders action against those filing false FIRs
item.description: Allahabad High Court orders UP police to act against false or malicious FIRs, warning that failure to prosecute such complainants could lead to prosecution and departmental action against erring officers.

item.title: BMC elections see turnout dip to 52.94 pc, down from 55.53 pc
item.description: Voter participation in Mumbai’s civic elections fell to 52.94 per cent, marking a decline from the 55.53 per cent recorded in the previous Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) polls in 2017, officials said on Friday.

item.title: Jharkhand issues Nipah alert after cases reported in West Bengal
item.description: The Jharkhand health department has issued a state-wide advisory directing district civil surgeons to intensify surveillance and preparedness measures against the Nipah virus, following the confirmation of two cases in neighbouring West Bengal.

item.title: Karnataka launches excavation at historic Lakkundi after gold discovery
item.description: The Karnataka government has begun a full-scale archaeological excavation in the historic village of Lakkundi in Gadag district following the discovery of gold ornaments during the construction of a house, officials said on Friday.
